recaptured.reason: Correction pass 1 (maintainer 2026-09-24: fix the RN bugs found): the popup saves what it shows, so a preset project it dropped, a hidden preset priority and cleared preset fields are not saved; a batch checks every line before any write. Renamed scenarios describe the fixed behavior.

a preset project deleted elsewhere is not saved; the task goes to the area the popup shows
a bad line refuses the whole batch before any project is created
